description: This file defines the HookConfigurationRepository interface, which extends JPA repository interfaces to manage HookConfiguration entities and provides a custom query for retrieving specific configuration values based on hook ID and field name.

classes.name: HookConfigurationRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for HookConfiguration entities, including a custom query method to find configuration field values by hook ID and field name.

methods.name: findOneByHookIdAndFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific field from HookConfiguration entities filtered by hook ID and field name.
